# Oklahoma Council of Public Affairs

> A leading Oklahoma policy think tank providing independent analysis, legislative scorecards, and data tools to inform public debate on education, fiscal policy, and judicial decisions.

OCPA is a nonpartisan research organization dedicated to promoting free-market principles and limited government in Oklahoma. The organization publishes policy analysis, maintains voting records for legislators and judges, and operates interactive data tools for government transparency.

## Key Topics

- Oklahoma policy analysis
- Legislative scorecard
- Judicial scorecard
- Education policy
- School choice
- Medicaid expansion
- State budget
- Economic policy
- Oklahoma Supreme Court
- Initiative petitions
- Minimum wage
- Government spending
- Fiscal transparency
- Policy advocacy

## Core Organization

- [Home](https://ocpathink.org): OCPA homepage promoting policy principles and analysis for Oklahoma
- [About](https://ocpathink.org/about): OCPA mission, leadership, and organization overview
- [Take Action](https://ocpathink.org/take-action): Legislative advocacy campaigns on reading reform and education policy
- [Donate](https://ocpathink.org/donate): Donation and fundraising page with membership levels and giving options

## Legislative & Judicial Scorecards

- [Legislative Scorecard](https://ocpathink.org/scorecard): Legislative voting records and scorecard for Oklahoma representatives
- [Oklahoma Judicial Scorecard](https://ocpathink.org/judicial-scorecard): Oklahoma Supreme Court justice voting records and judicial philosophy analysis
- [Comprehensive Case Review for Judicial Scorecard](https://research.ocpathink.org/comprehensive-case-review-for-judicial-scorecard): Detailed case analysis for Oklahoma Supreme Court judicial scorecard

## Policy Analysis & Articles

- [Articles](https://ocpathink.org/articles): Policy articles and analysis on Oklahoma education, economy, and reform
- [SQ 832 Sounds Compassionate—But It Would Shrink Opportunity](https://ocpathink.org/post/analysis/sq-832-sounds-compassionate-but-it-would-shrink-opportunity): Policy analysis opposing minimum wage increase initiative SQ 832
- [Medicaid-Expansion Follies Show Need for Initiative-Petition Reform](https://ocpathink.org/post/analysis/medicaid-expansion-follies-show-need-for-initiative-petition-reform): Analysis of Medicaid expansion and initiative petition reform in Oklahoma
- [In Oklahoma, Rich Kids Perform Poorly in School](https://ocpathink.org/post/independent-journalism/in-oklahoma-rich-kids-perform-poorly-in-school): Education analysis on student performance disparities in Oklahoma schools
- [As Demand Nears Cap, Parents Praise School-Choice Program](https://ocpathink.org/post/independent-journalism/as-demand-nears-cap-parents-praise-school-choice-program): Article on Oklahoma Parental Choice Tax Credit program and parent testimonials
- [Credit Upgrade Defies Prior Doomsday Predictions](https://ocpathink.org/post/independent-journalism/credit-upgrade-defies-prior-doomsday-predictions): Analysis of Oklahoma's credit rating upgrade and fiscal policy success
- [Oklahoma Remains a Top 10 State for Movers](https://ocpathink.org/post/independent-journalism/oklahoma-remains-a-top-10-state-for-movers): Report on Oklahoma's domestic migration trends and population growth

## Data & Research Tools

- [Data Tools](https://ocpathink.org/data-tools): Interactive tools for Oklahoma government spending, payroll, and pension data

## Media & Engagement
